meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测组织切片上每个位置的基因表达
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做病理或肿瘤研究,希望从常规染色切片得到基因表达数据
copy.tagline_en: Predict gene expression at every location from tissue slide images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study pathology or tumors and want gene expression from routine tissue slides

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 可调用 DeepSpot-M,从 H&E 组织学图像切块(224x224)预测指定蛋白编码基因的表达量(log1p-CPM),支持约 19k 基因按符号查询,并可将整张切片分块批量预测,输出基因×位置矩阵。
howto.when: 当用户需要 224x224 小块的空间基因表达(log1p-CPM)、按符号查询蛋白编码基因,或用 histolab 分块后做整张切片预测时。

say.text: 我想查询 MYC 基因在这个肿瘤切片上的空间表达分布。
say.note: 输出按网格排列的表达值。

say.text: 把这张切片用 histolab 分块,再批量预测这 5 个基因的表达。
say.note: 得到基因×位置矩阵,可放入 AnnData。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can use DeepSpot-M to predict spatial gene expression (log1p-CPM) for queried protein-coding genes from 224x224 H&E tiles, supporting a ~19k gene panel queried by symbol and whole-slide prediction by tiling with histolab.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs spatial gene expression for 224x224 tiles at ~20x, wants to query protein-coding genes by symbol, or wants whole-slide prediction after tiling with histolab.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D expression for this H&E tile using DeepSpot-M.
Query the spatial expression of MYC in this tumor section.
Tile this slide with histolab and predict expression for these 5 genes.
say_en.note: Produces a genes-by-tiles matrix for AnnData.
